key_reasoning.reason: Delivered work spans the AgentWorkspaceBrowserPopup, a new workspacePreview helper module (PreviewKind enum, front-matter split, safe JSON formatting, image helpers), the shared CodeBlock and CodeBlockExpandPopup (new optional hideDownload prop) and the shared FILE_EXTENSIONS map (exported, log/diff added), plus reuse of ExpandedYamlShell. Baseline M (3-4 components, one layer), bumped to L because shared components used across the app were changed.

About 9 source files: 2 new (workspacePreview.ts, __tests__/workspacePreview.test.ts) and 7 modified (AgentWorkspaceBrowserPopup.tsx, ChatHeaderBrowseFilesButton.test.tsx, CodeBlock.tsx, CodeBlockExpandPopup.tsx, fileExtensions.ts, CodeBlock.integration.test.tsx, CodeBlockExpandPopup.test.tsx) in 2 directories (pages/chat/.../ChatHeader, components/CodeBlock). Committed planning artifacts under docs/superpowers/tasks are left out of the count. The count comes from source inspection because no diffstat was supplied, so it is an estimate. 7-10 files maps to L.

Established patterns cover the rendering: the sanitized Markdown component, CodeBlock highlighting and ExpandedYamlShell. New logic includes BOM- and empty-front-matter-tolerant regex parsing, keeping unsafe large integers in JSON unformatted, and whole-name matching for Dockerfile and dotfiles. An additive optional prop on a widely used shared CodeBlock adds blast radius. Parameterized test templates (it.each) already exist, so the edge-case cases add no bump.

Core acceptance criteria were clear, but MR !2230 review forced design rework: reuse of the shared extension map and CodeBlock instead of a custom text renderer, and the shared popup instead of in-place enlarge with a capture-phase Esc listener. The spec was then revised. That is gap-driven rework at M level.

Supersedes the earlier pre-review actual (total 12, S, 4 files). The bundled S calibration example (epmcdme-10102, 3 files, additive) is clearly smaller than this delivery, which supports M. UI layer only, no new dependencies.
